intro: Small in size, big on function—our Goldust bedside table is the perfect companion to your bed, with compact form and classic elegance.

features.title: Space-saving style
features.text: Its compact profile makes it easy to place—ideal for smaller rooms or minimalist aesthetics.

features.title: Warm walnut tones
features.text: Finished in premium walnut, it blends beautifully with your bedroom setup and other furniture pieces.

features.title: Smart storage duo
features.text: A drawer and an open shelf provide just the right amount of space for your nighttime reads and essentials.

features.title: Harmonizes with ease
features.text: This bedside table pairs effortlessly with your bed and other furniture, creating a cohesive, calming space.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
